ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(7);
 RET NUMBER;
 DCLTN_REPS_PRINT NUMBER;

BEGIN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF (:START_DT IS NOT NULL OR :END_DT IS NOT NULL ) THEN 

select 1 INTO V_COUNT from dual where exists
(
(
SELECT 1 --COUNT(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT)
FROM DECLARATIONS DCLTN
WHERE DCLTN.PORT_CD=:port
 AND
(
(
:P_DCLTN_TYPE = 0 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) and
 ( (DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=:P_DCLTN_STA and :P_DCLTN_STA NOT IN (0 , 17 ))
 OR ( :P_DCLTN_STA =7 AND DCLTN.SPCL_DEPT_ID <>7 )
 OR ( :P_DCLTN_STA =0 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1,3,4,5,15)) 
 )
 
 and(:LICE_NO IS NULL OR DCLTN.IMPR_NBR = :LICE_NO)
 
)
------===
OR 
(
:P_DCLTN_TYPE = 1 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) and
( 
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=:P_DCLTN_STA and :P_DCLTN_STA NOT IN (0 , 10 )) 
 OR ( :P_DCLTN_STA =0 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1,2,3,4,11)) )
)
AND (:LICE_NO IS NULL OR DCLTN.AGENT_NBR = :LICE_NO)
)
and DCLTN.DCLTN_nbr = DCLTN.DCLTN_nbr
AND
---------------
(
(----5
--------
(----4
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_DT BETWEEN nvl(:START_DT,DCLTN.DCLTN_DT) AND nvl(:END_DT,DCLTN.DCLTN_DT))
 AND :CHECK1 = 0
)-----4

OR
(---1
(---3
 (---2
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_DT BETWEEN nvl(:START_DT,DCLTN.DCLTN_DT) AND nvl(:END_DT,DCLTN.DCLTN_DT))
 )---2
 OR DCLTN.DCLTN_DT IS NULL
)----3
AND :CHECK1 = 1
)----1
----
)-----5

)
 AND
 ( 
 ( :P_LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND :P_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 DCLTN.BRKR_PORT_CD = DECODE(:P_LIC_TYPE,2,99,5,99,:PORT) AND DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE AND 
 DCLTN.LIC_NBR = :P_LIC_NBR )
 OR
 (:P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL AND :P_LIC_NBR IS NULL )
 )
 

 )
----*************************************************************
UNION
(

SELECT 1 --COUNT(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT)
FROM DECLARATIONS DCLTN
WHERE DCLTN.PORT_CD=:port
 AND
(

(
:P_DCLTN_TYPE = 0 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) 
and (

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE load_list IS
 
 v_rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 F VARCHAR2(7);
 T VARCHAR2(11);
 BEGIN
 
 v_rg_id :=FIND_GROUP('DCLN_STA');
 if id_null(v_rg_id) then
 v_rg_id := create_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('DCLN_STA',
 'SELECT DISTINCT min( DCLTN_STA_DESC),TO_CHAR(DCLTN_STA_CD) 
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE ((DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1,3,4,5,7,15,17)AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0) OR 
 (DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1) AND DCLTN_STA_CD IN (1,2,3,4,10,11))
 group by DCLTN_STA_CD 
 UNION
 SELECT ''الكل'',
 ''0'' FROM DUAL
 ORDER BY 2
 ');
 
 END if;
 if populate_group(v_rg_id) = 0 then
 populate_list('P_DCLTN_STA',v_rg_id);
 
 
 END if;
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 v_rg_id :=FIND_GROUP('G_DCLTN_GRP');
 if id_null(v_rg_id) then
 v_rg_id := create_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('G_DCLTN_GRP',
 'SELECT DISTINCT min( GRP_NAME),TO_CHAR( GRP_ID) 
 FROM dcltn_grps
 group by GRP_ID 
 UNION
 SELECT ''الكل'',
 ''0'' FROM DUAL
 ORDER BY 2
 ');
 
 END if;
 if populate_group(v_rg_id) = 0 then
 populate_list('U_DCLTN_GRP',v_rg_id);
 
 
 END if;
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 END;
